title: Performance-CBOM v0.1 (native form)
description: A performance extension record for a CycloneDX CBOM algorithm asset. Native standalone form. See SPEC.md.

cbom_version.description: CycloneDX/CBOM spec version this record is compatible with. 1.6 or later.

standard.description: Standardizing document. Body-neutral: NIST FIPS 204, BSI TR-02102, ANSSI PG-083, CNSA 2.0, etc.

parameter_set.description: Parameter set or security category, e.g. Category 3.

build_flags.description: Build configuration materially affecting performance, e.g. OQS_DIST_BUILD.

measurement_id.description: Stable identifier for the specific measurement within the source.

ref_url.description: Resolvable URL to the authoritative measurement. Source of truth.

last_measured.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the referenced measurement.

commit.description: VCS commit hash of the measurement run.

snapshot.description: Cached values for offline consumers. Never authoritative; ref_url wins.

operation.description: Timed operation, e.g. sign, verify, keygen, encaps, decaps.

baseline.description: Delta versus the classical algorithm this asset replaces. Carries the faster-than-classical result as a machine-queryable field rather than prose.

pct_over_classical.description: Signed percentage vs the classical baseline for the same operation. Negative means the PQC asset is faster than the classical one.

comparison.description: Optional label for what the delta is measured against when not a bare primitive-vs-primitive figure.

deployment_use.description: Free-text usage. In v0.1 this is prose, NOT a modeled CycloneDX protocol asset.
